description: Read the user’s cloud-saved settings: interview preferences (language, translation, answer style, default knowledge bases, replay, web search…), exam answer customization (answer language, programming language, code style, code mode, extra requirements, quick prompts) and desktop client settings (hotkeys, overlay style, modes, auto-answer…). Custom prompts are shown as lengths only; read them with get_prompt_presets. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:read.)
name: get_settings
